name: hivemind-test-harness
description: Central integration test suite for HiveMind: topology, stress, and cross-repo scenarios built on hivescope
author: JarbasHiveMind

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
```bash
pip install "hivescope @ git+https://github.com/JarbasHiveMind/hivescope@dev"
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

For skill e2e tests (requires a live OVOS installation):

```bash
pip install -e ".[dev,ovos]"
```
